cupertino.notes: Round 86 (y3): audit 44 downgrade fixed. The sheet takes the increased-contrast blue for the Cupertino looks only (0040DD light, 409CFF dark, ring at 80 %): stepper glyph 5.4:1 hovered and 4.8:1 pressed on the pressed face in light, 3.8:1 and 3.0:1 in dark (were 2.3 to 2.96:1), keyboard ring 5.9:1 light and 4.5:1 dark (were 2.0 to 2.3:1). Viewed at 1.5x light and dark. | AUDIT 44 (1): downgraded from ready to review. Measured at the pixel: the stepper glyph (systemBlue 007AFF / 0A84FF) on the hovered plus half is 2.89:1 light and 2.96:1 dark, on the pressed half 2.57:1 and 2.34:1, under 3:1; the keyboard focus ring (a 40 percent blue) is 2.03:1 light and 2.26:1 dark against the page. The rest cell is 3.14:1 and 3.50:1. The sheet does not use the increased-contrast tinted blues of looks_y85. Fix: tint the glyph and the ring like card and rating. | AUDIT 43 (1): ready to review. The cells captioned 'hover (plus half)' and 'pressed (plus half)' hover and press the MINUS half: cup_stepper.e drives them with the harness pointer at the cell centre (no looks.aim), the stepper stands in the right of its 190 px cell and the centre falls on the minus half (the darker half is the left one in both looks, viewed 1x). The plus half's hover and pressed states are drawn nowhere. Contrast numbers hold (glyph 007AFF on E3E3E9 3.14:1, reproduced). Fix: looks.aim in cup_stepper.e as cup_splitter.e does. | ROUND 84 (lane y, batch 2, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): raised to ready by the maintainer's rule (UIStepper 94 x 32, measured 94 x 32 with the 1 px divider; no Flutter widget). Cupertino secondary label raised from 60 % to 80 % (light, 3C3C43) and 70 % (dark, EBEBF5) so secondary text holds 4.5:1; placeholder and tab-bar grey follow. Viewed light and dark, 1x and 1.5x, all twelve cells: values 18.8:1 and 17:1, accent glyphs 3.14:1 light and 3.5:1 dark on the pill (controls, 3:1). The keyboard ring wraps the focused half (rounded outside, straight at the divider), as a ring on a segment does; UIKit has no ring, macOS NSStepper rings the whole control, so this is a deliberate segment ring. From memory: 94 x 32, radius 8. | ROUND 85 (lane y, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): AUDIT 43 (2) fixed: cup_stepper.e aims the pointer at the plus half with looks.aim (also the spin box hover), so 'hover (plus half)' and 'pressed (plus half)' now draw the plus half darker; viewed all twelve cells light and dark at 1x and 1.5x. Glyph contrast unchanged (3.14:1 light, 3.5:1 dark, controls).
